items.title: Supermetrics lets Claude build ad campaigns on 6 platforms, paused by default

items.title: Google AI Overviews For Brands Move To Right Column
items.excerpt: Google has moved the AI Overviews for many brand-related keywords to the right-hand column of the search results page.  Previously, they appeared at the top or middle of the main search results section.
